items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: After that, the next time I recorded was with Art Tatum... We made four sides. Art -- I think he called them 'Art Tatum and his Swingsters'... I played clarinet on the record... Art Tatum played piano.

ctx.x: No, that's probably the first. After that, the next time I recorded was with Art Tatum.
